title_original: Operation and Certification of Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (14 CFR Part 107)

issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), U.S. Department of Transportation

title_original: Remote Identification of Unmanned Aircraft (14 CFR Part 89)
title_en: Remote Identification of Unmanned Aircraft (14 CFR Part 89)
notes: Requires most drones to broadcast identification and location (standard or broadcast module Remote ID); operator compliance from 2023-2024.

title_original: Operation of Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems Over People
title_en: Operation of Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems Over People
notes: Amends Part 107 to allow routine operations over people and moving vehicles by drone category and routine night operations with training.

title_original: Normalizing Unmanned Aircraft Systems Beyond Visual Line of Sight Operations (proposed 14 CFR Part 108)
title_en: Normalizing Unmanned Aircraft Systems Beyond Visual Line of Sight Operations (proposed 14 CFR Part 108)
notes: NPRM creating Part 108 for routine BVLOS drone ops at or below 400 ft (delivery, inspection), operator permits/certificates, automated data providers; comments reopened 2026; not yet in eCFR.

title_original: Designation-Restrict the Operation of Unmanned Aircraft in Close Proximity to a Fixed Site Facility (Section 2209 NPRM)
title_en: Designation-Restrict the Operation of Unmanned Aircraft in Close Proximity to a Fixed Site Facility (Section 2209 NPRM)
notes: Implements FAA Extension Act 2016 s.2209: process for critical infrastructure owners to request UAS flight restrictions near fixed sites.

title_original: Counter-UAS Authority for State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial Law Enforcement and Correctional Agencies (final rule)
title_en: Counter-UAS Authority for State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial Law Enforcement and Correctional Agencies (final rule)
issuer: U.S. Department of Justice / Department of Homeland Security (see Federal Register)
notes: Rule implementing expanded statutory authority for state/local law enforcement and correctional agencies to detect and mitigate drones.

title_original: Safe and Secure Operations of Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (ANPRM)
title_en: Safe and Secure Operations of Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (ANPRM)
notes: ANPRM seeking input on stand-off distances, payload limits, critical system design and remote ID to enable expanded sUAS ops; overtaken by 2025 Part 108 NPRM.

title_original: Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain: Unmanned Aircraft Systems (ANPRM)
title_en: Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain: Unmanned Aircraft Systems (ANPRM)
issuer: Bureau of Industry and Security, U.S. Department of Commerce
notes: ANPRM on restricting ICTS integral to UAS from foreign adversaries (China, Russia) under EO 13873; precursor to drone supply-chain rules.

title_original: Spectrum Rules and Policies for the Operation of Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: Spectrum Rules and Policies for the Operation of Unmanned Aircraft Systems
notes: FCC rules allowing UAS control links in the 5030-5091 MHz band and related operator/licensing framework.

title_original: Implementing Section 927 Waiver Process for Certain Unmanned Aircraft Operations
title_en: Implementing Section 927 Waiver Process for Certain Unmanned Aircraft Operations
notes: FAA notice implementing FAA Reauthorization Act 2024 s.927 streamlined waiver process for certain UAS operations.

title_original: Executive Order 14305: Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty
title_en: Executive Order 14305: Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty
notes: Directs federal counter-drone task force, enforcement against unlawful drone use, Section 2209 rulemaking and expanded C-UAS authority for state/local agencies.

title_original: Executive Order 14307: Unleashing American Drone Dominance
title_en: Executive Order 14307: Unleashing American Drone Dominance
notes: Directs FAA to issue BVLOS rule, promote US drone manufacturing, prioritize domestic drones in federal procurement, and advance eVTOL/AAM pilots.

title_original: Executive Order 13981: Protecting the United States From Certain Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: Executive Order 13981: Protecting the United States From Certain Unmanned Aircraft Systems
notes: Directs agencies to review and cease procurement/use of UAS manufactured by foreign adversaries (notably China) and assess security risks.

title_original: Presidential Memorandum: Unmanned Aircraft Systems Integration Pilot Program
title_en: Presidential Memorandum: Unmanned Aircraft Systems Integration Pilot Program
notes: Established the UAS Integration Pilot Program pairing state/local governments with industry to test advanced drone ops; program concluded 2020 (succeeded by BEYOND).

title_original: Presidential Memorandum: Promoting Economic Competitiveness While Safeguarding Privacy, Civil Rights, and Civil Liberties in Domestic Use of Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: Presidential Memorandum: Promoting Economic Competitiveness While Safeguarding Privacy, Civil Rights, and Civil Liberties in Domestic Use of Unmanned Aircraft Systems
notes: Sets privacy, civil-rights and transparency requirements for federal agencies' domestic drone use and launched NTIA multistakeholder privacy process.

title_original: FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024 (Public Law 118-63), Title IX Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024 (Public Law 118-63), Title IX Unmanned Aircraft Systems
notes: Mandates BVLOS rulemaking, Part 108 timeline, UAS test ranges, detection/mitigation pilots, AAM provisions and recreational drone rules.

title_original: FAA Reauthorization Act of 2018 (Public Law 115-254), Subtitle B Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: FAA Reauthorization Act of 2018 (Public Law 115-254), Subtitle B Unmanned Aircraft Systems
notes: Repealed Section 336 model-aircraft rule, created 49 USC 44809 recreational exception, mandated Remote ID, UTM, carriage of property rules and counter-UAS authorities.

title_original: FAA Modernization and Reform Act of 2012 (Public Law 112-95), Subtitle B Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: FAA Modernization and Reform Act of 2012 (Public Law 112-95), Subtitle B Unmanned Aircraft Systems
notes: First federal statutory framework directing FAA to integrate civil UAS into the national airspace (ss.331-336), test sites and sUAS rulemaking.

title_original: Preventing Emerging Threats Act of 2018 (6 U.S.C. s.124n)
title_en: Preventing Emerging Threats Act of 2018 (6 U.S.C. s.124n)
notes: Authorizes DHS and DOJ to detect, track, disrupt, seize or destroy drones posing credible threats to covered facilities or assets.

title_original: 49 U.S.C. s.44809 Exception for limited recreational operations of unmanned aircraft
title_en: 49 U.S.C. s.44809 Exception for limited recreational operations of unmanned aircraft
notes: Statutory conditions for recreational drone flying (TRUST safety test, CBO guidelines, 400 ft, Remote ID) replacing the Section 336 special rule.

title_original: 18 U.S.C. s.39B Unsafe operation of unmanned aircraft
title_en: 18 U.S.C. s.39B Unsafe operation of unmanned aircraft
notes: Federal criminal offense for knowingly or recklessly interfering with manned aircraft or operating drones in runway exclusion zones.

title_original: 49 U.S.C. s.44810 Airport safety and airspace hazard mitigation and enforcement
title_en: 49 U.S.C. s.44810 Airport safety and airspace hazard mitigation and enforcement
notes: Directs FAA to test and evaluate drone detection and mitigation technologies at airports and ensure they do not interfere with air navigation.

title_original: American Security Drone Act of 2023 (Public Law 118-31, NDAA FY2024 ss.1821-1833)
title_en: American Security Drone Act of 2023 (Public Law 118-31, NDAA FY2024 ss.1821-1833)
notes: Prohibits federal procurement and operation of drones made by covered foreign entities (e.g., China) and restricts federal funds for such drones.

title_original: National Defense Authorization Act for FY2025 (Public Law 118-159), Section 1709 (Countering CCP Drones)
title_en: National Defense Authorization Act for FY2025 (Public Law 118-159), Section 1709 (Countering CCP Drones)
notes: Requires national security review of DJI/Autel drones within one year; absent review, their equipment is added to the FCC Covered List (triggered Dec 2025).

title_original: John S. McCain NDAA for FY2019 (Public Law 115-232), Section 848 Prohibition on operation or procurement of foreign-made UAS
title_en: John S. McCain NDAA for FY2019 (Public Law 115-232), Section 848 Prohibition on operation or procurement of foreign-made UAS
notes: Bars Department of Defense from procuring or operating drones and components manufactured in China (expanded by later NDAAs).

title_original: FCC Public Notice DA 25-1086: Addition of foreign-produced UAS and UAS critical components to the Covered List
title_en: FCC Public Notice DA 25-1086: Addition of foreign-produced UAS and UAS critical components to the Covered List
notes: Adds foreign-made drones and critical components (incl. DJI, Autel) to the Covered List under NDAA FY2025 s.1709, blocking new FCC equipment authorizations.

title_original: FAA Advisory Circular 107-2A: Small Unmanned Aircraft System (Small UAS)
title_en: FAA Advisory Circular 107-2A: Small Unmanned Aircraft System (Small UAS)
notes: Guidance on complying with Part 107 including operations over people, night operations, remote pilot responsibilities and risk assessment.

title_original: Integration of Civil Unmanned Aircraft Systems in the National Airspace System (NAS) Roadmap, Third Edition
title_en: Integration of Civil Unmanned Aircraft Systems in the National Airspace System (NAS) Roadmap, Third Edition

title_original: Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Traffic Management (UTM) Concept of Operations v2.0
title_en: Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Traffic Management (UTM) Concept of Operations v2.0

title_original: Unmanned Aircraft Systems Beyond Visual Line of Sight Aviation Rulemaking Committee Final Report
title_en: Unmanned Aircraft Systems Beyond Visual Line of Sight Aviation Rulemaking Committee Final Report

title_original: Advisory on the Application of Federal Laws to the Acquisition and Use of Technology to Detect and Mitigate Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: Advisory on the Application of Federal Laws to the Acquisition and Use of Technology to Detect and Mitigate Unmanned Aircraft Systems

title_original: Advanced Air Mobility Coordination and Leadership Act (Public Law 117-203)
title_en: Advanced Air Mobility Coordination and Leadership Act (Public Law 117-203)

title_original: Countering CCP Drones Act (H.R. 2864, 118th Congress)
title_en: Countering CCP Drones Act (H.R. 2864, 118th Congress)
notes: Bill to add DJI equipment to the FCC Covered List under the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act; enacted in modified form as NDAA FY2025 s.1709.

title_original: American Security Drone Act of 2023 (S. 473, 118th Congress)
title_en: American Security Drone Act of 2023 (S. 473, 118th Congress)
notes: Stand-alone bill banning federal procurement of drones from covered foreign entities; enacted via NDAA FY2024 ss.1821-1833.

title_en: Block Nuclear Launch by Autonomous Artificial Intelligence Act of 2023 (S. 1394, 118th Congress)

title_en: SELF DRIVE Act (Safely Ensuring Lives Future Deployment and Research In Vehicle Evolution Act, H.R. 3388, 115th Congress)

title_original: AV START Act (American Vision for Safer Transportation through Advancement of Revolutionary Technologies Act, S. 1885, 115th Congress)
title_en: AV START Act (American Vision for Safer Transportation through Advancement of Revolutionary Technologies Act, S. 1885, 115th Congress)

title_en: Occupant Protection for Vehicles With Automated Driving Systems (FMVSS 200-series amendments)

title_en: ADS-Equipped Vehicle Safety, Transparency, and Evaluation Program (AV STEP) NPRM

title_en: Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 127: Automatic Emergency Braking Systems for Light Vehicles

title_en: FMVSS Modernization of FMVSS No. 108 To Accommodate ADS-Equipped Vehicles (NPRM)

title_en: FMVSS Modernization of FMVSS No. 135 To Accommodate ADS-Equipped Vehicles (NPRM)

title_en: Framework for Automated Driving System Safety (ANPRM)

title_en: Removing Regulatory Barriers for Vehicles With Automated Driving Systems (ANPRM)

title_en: Pilot Program for Collaborative Research on Motor Vehicles With High or Full Driving Automation (ANPRM)

title_en: Safe Integration of Automated Driving Systems-Equipped Commercial Motor Vehicles (ANPRM)

title_en: Hazardous Materials: Modernizing Regulations To Facilitate Transportation of Hazardous Materials Using Highly Automated Vehicles (NPRM)

title_en: Updating and Expanding Guidance on Safe Development and Deployment of Automated Driving Systems

title_en: AV Framework Updates and Request for Comments on Interim Guidance

title_en: Nuro, Inc.; Grant of Temporary Exemption for a Low-Speed Vehicle With an Automated Driving System

title_en: Standing General Order 2021-01: Incident Reporting for Automated Driving Systems and Level 2 ADAS (as amended 2023 and 2025)

title_en: Notice and Request for Comment: Proposal for a New United Nations Global Technical Regulation on Automated Driving Systems

title_en: Federal Automated Vehicles Policy: Accelerating the Next Revolution in Roadway Safety

title_en: Automated Driving Systems 2.0: A Vision for Safety

title_en: Preparing for the Future of Transportation: Automated Vehicles 3.0

title_en: Ensuring American Leadership in Automated Vehicle Technologies: Automated Vehicles 4.0

title_en: Automated Vehicle Transparency and Engagement for Safe Testing (AV TEST) Initiative

title_en: OSHA Directive STD 01-12-002: Guidelines for Robotics Safety

title_en: Robotically-Assisted Surgical Devices-Premarket Submissions; Draft Guidance for Industry and FDA Staff

title_en: Robotically-Assisted Surgical Devices: Challenges and Opportunities; Public Workshop; Request for Comments
